title: Saw so much in 3h!
text: Same Segway company twice in 2 days! Really nice boss that took me around, we went to so many places and he explained the history and showed me as many as he could as I was the only one on the tour. Appreciate it! Got a gift from him too!
author: Joanne_L

title: Great way to see city
text: It was a great tour. Nice guides.  Machines worked well. I would recommend as way to see lots of the city without tiring out
author: charlie_n

title: This tour is a definite must-do!
text: Our Segway tour in Barcelona with Leo as our guide was absolutely fantastic! The experience was so much fun that we couldn't resist coming back for another tour the very next day. Thanks to Leo's expert guidance, we were able to explore and discover so much of Barcelona effortlessly. Highly, highly recommended – this tour is a definite must-do if you want to make the most of your time in the city!
author: 3rikaL

title: Awesome way to see the city
text:
I started the tour being skeptical about riding a Segway but this turned out to be an amazing experience. The tour itself was pretty great. My tour guide (nino) took us around the city showing some of the awesome architectural wonders in Barcelona.
Would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see the city in a short duration and have lots of fun while seeing it.
author: Sneha_H
